Appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y.; and

Appeal from D. C. D. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 398 U. S. 903.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted and 20 additional minutes allotted for argument on behalf of the United States.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
